digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13)
Exactly 19 inventoried test nodes perform immutable repository text/AST inspection with results independent of platform or Python version
The shared workflow applies identical default marker expressions to all matrix cells, wasting runner-seconds on macOS for invariant static checks

Repository policy tests must be registered with a strict pytest marker, applied only to the 19 function-level nodes, collected in Ubuntu 3.13 default selection, and excluded from the other three default selections using an and not repo_policy selector
No new CI job, runner, checkout, install, collection session, or fixture session can be added; the solution must route within the existing Ubuntu 3.13 cell
